subject: general
question: Taramati peak is located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Taramati Peak:-**

 
 
• One of the two peaks of **Harishchandragad** is named **Taramati**. With a height of **1431 meters** (4695 feet) above sea level, this peak is the **sixth highest in Maharashtra **State, right behind Salher.
 
• Due to its **natural beauty**, this location, which lies on the **Harishchandragad Plateau**, makes for an excellent hiking experience for both beginners and specialists.
 
• At the extreme** border** of the peak, a section of the** thick jungle** gives way to a **grass path** and some challenging rock climbs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The top five mountain summits in India are as follows:

 
 

 __**Mountain Peak**__
 __**Height**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 **K2**
 **8611** meters
 
 
 
• Between **Baltistan** and **Xinjiang** is where the Indian subcontinent's tallest peak is located.
 
• In the **Karakoram**, it is the tallest peak.
 
 
 
 

 **Kangchenjunga**
 **8586** meters
 
 
 
• The **third-highest** summit on Earth.
 
• It is located in the **Himalayan mountain** range.
 
 
 
 

 **Nanda Devi**
 **7816** meters
 
 
 
• Listed as the **23rd tallest peak **on the planet.
 
• The best high-altitude vegetation and animals can be found in the nearby **Nanda Devi National Park.**
 
• The tallest mountain wholly within India is this one.
 
• The **Himalayan mountain ranges** contain it.
 
 
 
 

 **Kamet**
 **7756** meters
 
 
 
• In close proximity to the **Tibetan Plateau.**
 
• It is situated in the region of **Garhwal.**
 
 
 
 

 **Saltoro Kangri**
 **7742** meters
 
 
 
• It is close to the region of **Siachen.**
 
• The Saltoro Kangri is listed as the world's 31st-highest **freestanding peak.**
 
• It is located in the **Karakoram Mountain range**'s Saltoro Range.
